items.name: cue
items.title: Cue
items.description: Imperative React overlays with isolated Cue environments, typed shared components, and one shared backdrop.
items.docs: Install a local Cue configuration with shadcn Dialog and create overlays with cue.createOverlay(...). The generated Cue module includes the native backdrop adapter and typed Dialog component map. Add showBackdrop={false} support to DialogContent as described in the docs. https://cue.vlkstudio.com/docs
